steps.zh: 装上唯一的 deno 可执行文件
steps.code: curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh · brew install deno

steps.en: Write a TypeScript server against web-standard Request and Response
steps.zh: 用 Web 标准 Request / Response 写个 TS 服务

steps.en: Run it and grant only network access
steps.zh: 运行它，只授予网络权限

steps.en: Runs the .ts file directly, with no tsconfig or build step
steps.zh: 直接运行 .ts 文件，不用 tsconfig、不用先编译

steps.en: Denies file, env and subprocess access you did not grant
steps.zh: 没授权的文件、环境变量、子进程访问一律拒绝
在 http://localhost:8000 上响应请求

value.en: A TypeScript service with no build pipeline that can only touch what you explicitly allowed
value.zh: 没有构建流水线的 TypeScript 服务，而且只能碰你明确放行的资源

sources: https://github.com/denoland/deno README (install.sh, brew install deno, Deno.serve server.ts, deno run --allow-net server.ts, localhost:8000)
https://docs.deno.com/runtime/fundamentals/security/ (no access to file system, network, environment or subprocesses by default)
